ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 5% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid low-intensity field. High-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips and scattered as fine speckling across the mid-left and mid-right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the total vertical pixel height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary. Pixel-amplitude variations range from 3 to 15 pixels. A prominent jagged irregularity is located on the inner margin of the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed along the trailing boundaries of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters detected on the superior margins of the left and right distal tips, indicative of localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white diagonal and horizontal linear pixel disruptions; high density of unaligned marks localized on the mid-left lobe and the central-right lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular missing segment or tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch; extensive linear rake-mark scarring distributed across both ventral lobes.
